summary: First testing pass for Malabar Stores site (React SPA + FastAPI Razorpay endpoints). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass covering root health, create-order (400 for zero/negative, 422 for missing amount, expected 502 with placeholder Razorpay keys) and verify (200 {verified:false} for invalid signature, 422 for missing fields). Frontend: full E2E verified on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) via Playwright: hero/nav/about/products/reviews/visit/footer render; all 7 product images load successfully (chakkavaraty, payasam-mix, eladda-ragi-ada, pickles, vatteppam, coconut, achappam); add-to-cart flow with +/- quantity steppers works; floating cart button + badge with correct item count and subtotal (₹260 for 2x chakkavaraty + 1x payasam-mix); cart drawer opens/closes; UPI deep links carry correct VPA (kasar1999@okicici), merchant name, and amount; delivery address inputs accept text; Razorpay 'Pay Online' button disabled when subtotal=0 (only Ask-in-store items) and enabled when subtotal>0; clicking Pay Online loads checkout.js (200), POSTs to /api/payments/create-order (502 as expected), and gracefully displays 'Could not start payment. Please try again.' via data-testid=payment-status-message while button reverts from 'Processing...' back to 'Pay ₹130 Now'. Mobile hamburger menu toggles nav; no horizontal overflow. No page errors, no broken images, no dead links.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses os.environ['RAZORPAY_KEY_ID'] at import time (hard fail if not set) - acceptable for now but could use os.environ.get with a startup validation for a clearer error.

Frontend App.js is 612 lines and mixes site content + cart + payment logic. Consider splitting into components (Header, Hero, Products, Cart, Payment) and extracting cart state into a hook for maintainability once feature set grows.

Ingress rewrites backend JSON 5xx bodies to an HTML 'Bad gateway' page (external 502 response body is HTML, not the FastAPI {detail:...} JSON). Frontend axios treats any non-2xx as error so behavior is unaffected, but if any future feature relies on reading error detail from a 5xx, this ingress behavior needs a workaround (return 200 with error field, or use 4xx).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Razorpay is intentionally on placeholder keys - create-order returning 502 is expected. Only real payment completion end-to-end cannot be tested until real Razorpay keys are added. verify endpoint works fully (local HMAC). Note that the Kubernetes ingress replaces backend 5xx JSON bodies with an HTML error page - if you need to assert JSON error content from backend, hit http://localhost:8001 directly or use 4xx status codes.
